notThis: it is NOT a traditional operating system
it does NOT run on desktop/mobile devices
it does NOT have a CLI or terminal

CardForge.description: AI-powered RPG card creator with visual editor, arena battles, deck builder, and public gallery
notThis: it is NOT a trading card marketplace
it does NOT support card trading or selling
it does NOT integrate with MTG/Pokemon/Yu-Gi-Oh

StoryForge.description: AI interactive fiction game with RPG mechanics, multiple genres, and branching narratives
notThis: it is NOT a writing tool or word processor
it does NOT generate novels or ebooks
it does NOT export to PDF

PixelAgents.description: AI agent marketplace with 24 built-in agents, creator economy with Stripe Connect payouts, Pro tier ($12/mo), and visual Agent Forge builder
features: 24 built-in agents across 12 categories: Roast My Site, Thread It, Name Storm, Validate This, Pitch Doctor, Vibe Check, Fridge Raid, Prompt Forge, Resume Roast, Signal, Hype Check, Buzz Check, Hivemind, Site Glow-Up, Color Thief, Roast My LinkedIn, Explain Like I'm 5, Startup Obituary, Legal Eagle, Email Fixer, Code Roast, Meeting Killer, Plot Twist, Debate Me
text-only agents, web search agents (Brave API), URL fetch agents, image generation agents (Gemini)
creator marketplace: publish agents, earn revenue from every run via Stripe Connect
Pro tier ($12/mo): 70% revenue share, 1.5x catalog weight, unlimited agents
Free tier: 50% revenue share, 1x weight, 5 agents max
Agent Forge: visual no-code builder with AI-generated Arcane-style portraits
shareable result cards with server-generated OG images for social sharing
creator analytics dashboard with leaderboard and payout history
docs center, FAQ, changelog, contact form
notThis: it is NOT a web scraper
it does NOT browse URLs interactively
it does NOT fill forms
it does NOT export CSV files
agents do NOT have persistent memory between sessions
it is NOT a ChatGPT alternative — agents are purpose-built specialists, not general chatbots
Pro tier revenue share is NOT a salary — creators earn per agent run

AmbientScore.description: Website conversion scoring tool that analyzes landing pages for conversion optimization
notThis: it is NOT an SEO tool
it does NOT track rankings
it does NOT monitor competitors
it is NOT an accessibility or WCAG compliance tool

Blindspot.description: Browser-based arena combat card RPG — no download, no install. Players build a fighter card, battle through a 10-boss campaign, then enter async PvP
features: async PvP with Elo ranking and defense queue
card progression with border evolution and title milestones
loot crates, cosmetics, battle charms, consumable items
Forge for card customization (stats, look, details)
Sparks economy (earn from battles, spend in shop)
per-card battle history with nemesis tracking
notThis: it is NOT a trading card game — no card marketplace or trading
it is NOT CardForge — Blindspot is a standalone game, fully decoupled
it does NOT require download or install — 100% browser-based
it does NOT use real money for gameplay — Sparks are earned in-game
cards are NOT randomly generated — players build them in Quick Build or Forge
it is NOT turn-based strategy — it's real-time move selection with rock-paper-scissors combat

AgentForge.description: Visual no-code agent builder where creators design, test, and publish custom AI agents to the Pixel Agents marketplace
features: test before submit with live preview
AI gatekeeper auto-approve (scores quality, uniqueness, safety)
Stripe Connect payout integration for creators
community catalog with search and filtering
edit gates for live agent cosmetic updates
notThis: it is NOT a coding tool
it does NOT generate code
it does NOT deploy agents to external platforms
